keyPoints.en: Heat is energy transferred from a hotter object to a colder one; temperature measures how hot an object is.
keyPoints.bm: Haba ialah tenaga yang dipindahkan dari objek lebih panas ke objek lebih sejuk; suhu mengukur darjah kepanasan objek.

keyPoints.en: Thermal equilibrium: two objects in thermal contact have the same temperature and no net heat flow.
keyPoints.bm: Keseimbangan terma: dua objek dalam sentuhan terma mempunyai suhu sama dan tiada aliran haba bersih.

keyPoints.en: A thermometer reads correctly only after it reaches thermal equilibrium with what it measures.
keyPoints.bm: Termometer membaca dengan betul hanya selepas mencapai keseimbangan terma dengan objek yang diukur.

keyPoints.en: Examples: cooling drinks with ice, a cold towel on a feverish forehead, cooking food in an oven.
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: menyejukkan minuman dengan ais, tuala sejuk di dahi yang demam, memasak makanan dalam ketuhar.

question.en: A hot spoon is placed in cool water. Describe the heat flow until equilibrium.
question.bm: Sudu panas diletakkan dalam air sejuk. Huraikan aliran haba hingga keseimbangan.

answer.en: Net heat flows from spoon to water until both reach the same temperature; then net flow is zero.
answer.bm: Haba bersih mengalir dari sudu ke air sehingga kedua-duanya mencapai suhu sama; kemudian aliran bersih sifar.

tip.en: Say 'net rate of heat transfer is zero', not 'no heat transfer'.
tip.bm: Sebut 'kadar pemindahan haba bersih ialah sifar', bukan 'tiada pemindahan haba'.

keyPoints.en: Heat capacity C = Q/θ: heat needed to raise an object's temperature by 1 °C.
keyPoints.bm: Muatan haba C = Q/θ: haba untuk menaikkan suhu objek sebanyak 1 °C.

keyPoints.en: Specific heat capacity c = Q/(mθ): heat needed to raise 1 kg by 1 °C. Unit J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹.
keyPoints.bm: Muatan haba tentu c = Q/(mθ): haba untuk menaikkan 1 kg sebanyak 1 °C. Unit J kg⁻¹ °C⁻¹.

keyPoints.en: High c (water 4200): heats and cools slowly — coolants, hot-water bottles, sea breeze.
keyPoints.bm: c tinggi (air 4200): lambat panas dan lambat sejuk — penyejuk, beg air panas, bayu laut.

keyPoints.en: Low c (metals ~400–900): heats quickly — cooking pots, but use a handle with high c / poor conductor.
keyPoints.bm: c rendah (logam ~400–900): cepat panas — periuk memasak, tetapi pemegang guna bahan c tinggi / konduktor lemah.

question.en: 0.5 kg of oil (c = 2000) is heated from 30 °C to 80 °C. Find Q.
question.bm: 0.5 kg minyak (c = 2000) dipanaskan dari 30 °C ke 80 °C. Cari Q.

tip.en: In mixing problems: heat lost by the hot object = heat gained by the cold object.
tip.bm: Dalam masalah campuran: haba hilang oleh objek panas = haba diterima oleh objek sejuk.

keyPoints.en: Latent heat is absorbed or released during a change of state at constant temperature.
keyPoints.bm: Haba pendam diserap atau dibebaskan semasa perubahan keadaan pada suhu malar.

keyPoints.en: Specific latent heat L = Q/m. Fusion (melting/freezing) and vaporisation (boiling/condensing).
keyPoints.bm: Haba pendam tentu L = Q/m. Pelakuran (lebur/beku) dan pengewapan (didih/kondensasi).

keyPoints.en: On a heating curve, flat sections = change of state; sloping sections = temperature rising.
keyPoints.bm: Pada lengkung pemanasan, bahagian mendatar = perubahan keadaan; bahagian condong = suhu meningkat.

keyPoints.en: Steam burns are worse than boiling-water burns because steam releases extra latent heat as it condenses.
keyPoints.bm: Lecur stim lebih teruk daripada air mendidih kerana stim membebaskan haba pendam tambahan semasa terkondensasi.

question.en: Heat to boil away 0.1 kg of water at 100 °C? (L_v = 2.26 × 10⁶ J kg⁻¹)
question.bm: Haba untuk mendidihkan habis 0.1 kg air pada 100 °C? (L_v = 2.26 × 10⁶ J kg⁻¹)

tip.en: Multi-step problems: do Q = mcθ for each temperature change and Q = mL for each change of state, then add.
tip.bm: Masalah berbilang langkah: guna Q = mcθ untuk setiap perubahan suhu dan Q = mL untuk setiap perubahan keadaan, kemudian tambah.

keyPoints.en: Gas pressure comes from molecules colliding with the container walls.
keyPoints.bm: Tekanan gas terhasil daripada molekul berlanggar dengan dinding bekas.

keyPoints.en: Boyle's law (constant T): P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ — smaller volume → more frequent collisions → higher pressure.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum Boyle (T malar): P₁V₁ = P₂V₂ — isi padu kecil → perlanggaran lebih kerap → tekanan lebih tinggi.

keyPoints.en: Charles' law (constant P): V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂ — hotter gas expands.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum Charles (P malar): V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂ — gas panas mengembang.

keyPoints.en: Gay-Lussac's law (constant V): P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂ — hotter gas, faster molecules, higher pressure.
keyPoints.bm: Hukum Gay-Lussac (V malar): P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂ — gas panas, molekul laju, tekanan tinggi.

keyPoints.en: Always use kelvin in gas laws: T = θ + 273. Absolute zero 0 K = −273 °C.
keyPoints.bm: Sentiasa guna kelvin dalam hukum gas: T = θ + 273. Sifar mutlak 0 K = −273 °C.

question.en: A tyre is at 200 kPa at 27 °C. After driving it reaches 57 °C. Find the new pressure (volume constant).
question.bm: Tayar pada 200 kPa pada 27 °C. Selepas dipandu suhunya 57 °C. Cari tekanan baharu (isi padu malar).

tip.en: Pressure units just need to match on both sides — kPa is fine; temperature must be in K.
tip.bm: Unit tekanan hanya perlu sama di kedua-dua belah — kPa boleh; suhu mesti dalam K.
